muxt fmt

flags:
--diff
  shorthand: "d"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "print a unified diff instead of the formatted source"
--list
  shorthand: "l"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "list files whose formatting differs"
--write
  shorthand: "w"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "write the result to the source file instead of standard output"

--help:
Format Go HTML templates, as gofmt formats Go. With no paths, format
standard input; directories are walked for *.gohtml files.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/fmt.md

Usage:
  muxt fmt [flags] [path ...]

Flags:
  -d, --diff    print a unified diff instead of the formatted source
  -h, --help    help for fmt
  -l, --list    list files whose formatting differs
  -w, --write   write the result to the source file instead of standard output

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
